name: referly
description: Manage your Referly affiliate program from ChatGPT: reports, affiliates, commissions, coupons and payout preparation.

interface.longDescription:
Manage your Referly affiliate program from ChatGPT. Referly is software that businesses use to run affiliate and referral programs: partners share links and coupon codes, and Referly tracks the sales they bring in and the commissions they earn. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Referly account, so you can report on your program, manage affiliates and commissions, and prepare payouts in plain language instead of clicking through the dashboard.

What you can do:
- Report: top affiliates by revenue, program KPIs for any period, and referrals, sales and commissions with filters.
- Manage affiliates: approve or decline applications, invite affiliates, and move them between groups and commission plans.
- Handle commissions: review commissions on hold and approve or decline them, one at a time or in bulk.
- Prepare payouts: build payout batches for what's due. Payouts are never sent from ChatGPT. The batch is prepared and you send it from the Referly dashboard.
- Run the program: affiliate links, coupons and promo codes, commission plans, announcements and emails, portal settings, webhooks and tracking checks.

How it keeps you in control:
- You sign in with your Referly account (OAuth). No API key is pasted into chat. You choose which program the connection can see and which permissions it gets.
- Bulk and destructive changes return a preview first and only run after you confirm.
- The plugin never moves money and never returns API keys, tokens or full payout account details.
- Every call is recorded in an activity log under Settings, AI apps & MCP in Referly, where you can revoke access at any time.

Who it's for: owners and team members of a Referly affiliate program. You need a Referly account. Some tools follow your account's features, and say so when a feature isn't available.
defaultPrompt: Who were my top 5 affiliates last month by revenue?
Which commissions are on hold and need a decision?
Prepare payouts for every affiliate who is owed commission.

positive.prompt: Who were my top 5 affiliates last month by revenue, and how did they do compared with the month before?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of the 5 affiliates with last month's revenue and the change from the month before, from the Northwind Studio sample data.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my affiliate program for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises affiliates, referrals, sales, revenue and commissions for the last 30 days.

positive.description: Create a group and move affiliates (write with preview)
positive.prompt: Create an affiliate group called VIP and move my top 3 affiliates into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the top 3 affiliates, creates the VIP group and assigns them after the user confirms; ChatGPT asks for confirmation before each write.

positive.prompt: Prepare payouts for every affiliate who is owed commission, and tell me the total.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews who is owed what and the total, prepares a payout batch only after confirmation, and returns a link to review and send it in the Referly dashboard. No money is sent.

positive.prompt: Draft an announcement for my affiliates about our Black Friday promotion. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a draft announcement (not published) and returns its title and a link to edit it in Referly.

negative.prompt: Send $500 to my top affiliate's PayPal right now.
Show me the Stripe API key and webhook secret connected to my Referly account.
Show me the affiliates and revenue of a competitor's Referly program.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Payout tools only prepare batches that the account owner sends from the Referly dashboard.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: affiliate program reporting, affiliate and commission management, coupons and links, announcements, and payout preparation (money is never sent from ChatGPT).
